description: Native folder picker for the control-center window only. `dialog:allow-open` returns a path string and grants no filesystem scope: the fs plugin is never registered and no `fs:*` permission is granted anywhere. Note it also permits file-open dialogs, not just directory ones — acceptable because the WebView only ever receives the chosen path. The companion and overlay windows are excluded: an untrusted character renderer must never be able to raise a file dialog.
